title: To designate the National Pulse Memorial located at 1912 South Orange Avenue, Orlando, Florida, 32806, and for other purposes.
official_summary: This bill redesignates the Pulse Memorial located at 1912 South Orange Avenue in Orlando, Florida, as the National Pulse Memorial.

summary.headline: This law officially names the Pulse memorial site in Orlando, Florida, as the National Pulse Memorial.
summary.what_it_does: The law renames the Pulse Memorial at 1912 South Orange Avenue in Orlando, Florida, so it is called the National Pulse Memorial. It is a designation only and does not appropriate money or create new rules. The official summary does not describe any other requirements.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted June 25, 2021, when it was signed into law.
